# Brewio

> Brewio is a free coffee journal app for iOS. It helps coffee lovers log their brews, time pour-overs, calculate ratios, track extraction yield, and discover their perfect cup.

## About
Brewio is built for the curious coffee drinker who wants more than just caffeine. Whether you pull espresso or brew V60, Brewio gives you the tools to dial in your craft and remember every great cup. Made in Sweden.

## Key Features
- Coffee brew journal — log every brew with method, bean, dose, ratio, and tasting notes
- 12 brew methods with step-by-step timers — V60, Espresso, Chemex, AeroPress, French Press, Moka Pot, Cold Brew, Kalita Wave, Siphon, Drip, Ibrik/Cezve, and Freddo Espresso
- Coffee-to-water ratio calculator per method
- Extraction yield (EY%) calculator from TDS%, for filter and espresso
- Grind size guidance per brew method
- Dial-in advice — diagnoses sour, bitter, or flat cups and suggests corrections
- Bean stash — track roast dates, freshness windows, and remaining weight
- Specialty roaster directory — curated roasters worldwide, filterable by origin and shipping
- Taste profile, origin map, streaks, badges, and a weekly recap
- Available in 15 languages

## Availability
- Free on iOS: https://apps.apple.com/app/brewio-brew-track/id6762492301
- Android: not yet released

## Free Tools (no signup)
- [Coffee Ratio Calculator](https://brewio.app/tools/coffee-ratio-calculator/): Coffee-to-water ratio for 12 brew methods
- [Coffee Grind Size Chart](https://brewio.app/tools/grind-size-chart/): Visual grind scale from Turkish-fine to cold-brew coarse
- [Extraction Yield Calculator](https://brewio.app/tools/extraction-yield-calculator/): TDS% to EY%, filter and espresso modes
- [Brew Timer](https://brewio.app/tools/brew-timer/): Step-by-step timers for all 12 methods
